excludedSources.description: Items left out because they look like instructions aimed at the model.

runtimeUsed.description: False when no readable item matched and the runtime was not called.

myRecordedOperations.description: Retry receipts kept for this account's operations in this campaign.

sharedByOthers.description: Items other members currently share with everyone.

head.description: Sync cursor at the time of this page; resume `/sync` from the first page's value.

aiService.description: Server AI (M25.10): "configured" when the operator set a runtime, else "not installed".

locale.description: Interface language of the asking client; the answer follows it.

model.description: One of the models the operator allowed (see the status endpoint).
